tooling: Existing runner/worker extended with bounded five-action scenario, native evidence evaluation and transcript export.
validation: G1–G25 controls, coverage registry and bounded regression lanes.
documentation: Nine reports, guide and current session handoff.
generated_artifacts: Selected transcripts, JUnit/logs, source diff/status and protected hashes.

testing.focused: 33 gameplay and 35 prior harness/registry checks passed.
testing.broader: 586 passed / six matching pre-existing failures; no timeout or error.
testing.runtime_validation: Owned localhost HTTP and production pipeline, synthetic SDK and external socket denial.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Three rich-opening, one stew-price conversation and two stale source-attestation assertions.

decisions_requiring_human_review: External review of conditional readiness and six-request feasibility before any separately authorized Live invocation.

campaign_specific: No end-to-end successful five-turn execution under six requests demonstrated; G1 is evaluator-only. Narrative quality and complete authority need human review.
pre_existing: Six baseline failures; stale ATGB source attestations are not rewritten.

does_not_prove: Live meaningful five-turn play, rendered UI, conversational competence, independent generalization or ATGB performance.
recommended_next_step: External review only; do not execute the future Live command in this pass.
self_contained_review_test: Nine reports, scenario/source/diff, G1–G25/JUnit/regression evidence, complete selected synthetic HTTP example, feasibility and future command.
